h1: Custom Wovin Lanyards & Badges for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Wovin Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Wovin lanyards and badges in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Durable, full-color woven designs ideal for events and daily use.
introHtml: Wovin lanyards are known for their tight, full-color woven construction that produces crisp logos and text without peeling or fading. Unlike printed lanyards, the design is integrated into the weave, making them a durable choice for daily badge wear at trade shows, corporate offices, or schools. Choose from styles like the 1" Knit-In Lanyard or the 3/4" Woven Lanyard, and pair them with custom badge holders or retractable reels for a complete ID solution.
heroAltText: Custom Wovin lanyards and badges with woven full-color logo, durable design for events and corporate use.
